en: Comparison is the thief of joy.
zh: 比较是偷走快乐的贼。

en: You can't pour from an empty cup.
zh: 杯子空了，就倒不出水来。

en: Done is better than perfect.
zh: 完成，胜过完美。

en: Small steps, taken daily, go far.
zh: 每天一小步，终能走很远。

en: What you focus on grows.
zh: 你关注什么，什么就生长。

en: Rest is part of the work.
zh: 休息，也是努力的一部分。

en: Be kind; everyone is fighting a hard battle.
zh: 善待他人，每个人都在与生活苦战。

en: Progress, not perfection.
zh: 要进步，不必完美。

en: The body keeps score — listen to it.
zh: 身体会记账，记得倾听它。

en: You're allowed to start over, today.
zh: 你随时可以重新开始，就从今天。

en: A walk can fix more than you think.
zh: 散个步，能治愈的比你想的多。

en: Slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.
zh: 慢即是稳，稳即是快。

en: Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now.
zh: 自律，是为最想要的，放下眼前想要的。

en: Worry is a poor use of imagination.
zh: 忧虑，是对想象力的浪费。

en: Eat real food, not too much, mostly plants.
zh: 吃真食物，别太多，多吃蔬菜。

en: You don't have to finish it all at once.
zh: 不必一口气全部做完。

en: Gratitude turns enough into plenty.
zh: 感恩，让“足够”变成“丰盛”。

en: The best time to plant a tree was years ago; the next best is now.
zh: 种树最好的时间是多年前，其次是现在。

en: Feelings are visitors — let them come and go.
zh: 情绪是过客，让它来，也让它走。

en: Your pace is still progress.
zh: 按自己的节奏走，也是前进。

en: Drink water before you reach for more.
zh: 再吃之前，先喝口水。

en: Saying no makes room for your yes.
zh: 学会拒绝，才有空间答应真正重要的事。

en: Courage is feeling the fear and going anyway.
zh: 勇气，是带着恐惧依然向前。

en: Health is the wealth you notice only when it's gone.
zh: 健康是财富，失去时才察觉。

en: Be where your feet are.
zh: 人在哪里，心就在哪里。

en: Tend your own garden first.
zh: 先照料好自己的花园。

en: Hard days build strong people.
zh: 难熬的日子，造就坚韧的人。

en: Less, but better.
zh: 少一点，但好一点。

en: You become your small daily habits.
zh: 日复一日的小习惯，塑造了你。

en: It's okay to be a work in progress.
zh: 还在成长，没关系。

en: Sleep is the cheapest medicine.
zh: 睡眠，是最便宜的良药。

en: Don't trade health for goals, then goals for health.
zh: 别用健康换目标，最后又用目标换健康。

en: The obstacle is often the way.
zh: 障碍，往往正是出路。

en: Speak to yourself as you would to a friend.
zh: 像对朋友那样，对自己说话。

en: Energy flows where attention goes.
zh: 注意力到哪里，能量就到哪里。

en: A full life is built from ordinary days.
zh: 丰盈的人生，由平凡的日子堆成。

en: Move your body; it carries your mind.
zh: 动一动身体，它承载着你的心。

en: What's easy to start is easy to keep.
zh: 容易开始的事，才容易坚持。

en: Let go, or be dragged.
zh: 放手，否则被拖着走。

en: Stillness is also an answer.
zh: 静止，也是一种答案。

en: You can do hard things.
zh: 再难的事，你也做得到。

en: Plans are nothing; planning is everything.
zh: 计划本身不重要，规划的过程才重要。

en: Choose the discomfort that grows you.
zh: 选择让你成长的那种不适。

en: Nourish, don't punish.
zh: 滋养自己，而非惩罚自己。

en: Today's effort is tomorrow's ease.
zh: 今天的努力，是明天的轻松。

en: The grass is greener where you water it.
zh: 你浇灌的地方，草才更绿。

en: Begin again, gently.
zh: 温柔地，重新开始。

en: One meal won't make or break you.
zh: 一顿饭，成不了也毁不了你。

en: Trust the process you can't yet see.
zh: 相信你还看不见的过程。

en: Peace is a skill you practice.
zh: 平静，是一种需要练习的能力。

en: Compare yourself to who you were yesterday.
zh: 和昨天的自己比就好。

en: Hunger and boredom often wear the same face.
zh: 饥饿和无聊，常常长得很像。

en: What you allow is what will continue.
zh: 你纵容什么，什么就会继续。

en: Strong roots make a calm tree.
zh: 根扎得深，树才不慌。

en: Tiny gains compound.
zh: 微小的进步，会复利成长。

en: You owe yourself an honest rest.
zh: 你欠自己一次真正的休息。

en: Direction matters more than speed.
zh: 方向，比速度更重要。

en: Be the calm in your own storm.
zh: 做自己风暴里的那份平静。

en: Add good things; the bad finds less room.
zh: 多添些好的，坏的就没了位置。

en: Patience is also a form of action.
zh: 耐心，也是一种行动。

en: Your worth isn't a number on a scale.
zh: 你的价值，不是秤上的数字。

en: Show up, especially when you don't feel like it.
zh: 越不想做的时候，越要出现。

en: Breathe first; decide second.
zh: 先呼吸，再决定。

en: Good enough, repeated, beats perfect, once.
zh: 持续的“还不错”，胜过一次的“完美”。

en: Kindness to yourself is not weakness.
zh: 善待自己，不是软弱。

en: Fill your plate with color.
zh: 让你的餐盘多些色彩。

en: Momentum loves a small start.
zh: 势头，偏爱小小的开始。

en: Not every thought deserves your belief.
zh: 不是每个念头都值得你相信。

en: It's fine to go slow — just don't stop.
zh: 走得慢没关系，只要别停。

en: Today is a fresh page.
zh: 今天，是崭新的一页。

en: Protect your mornings.
zh: 守护好你的早晨。

en: Celebrate small wins; they add up.
zh: 为小小的胜利喝彩，它们会累积。

en: Your future self is watching — make them proud.
zh: 未来的你在看着，别让他失望。

en: Eat slowly; your body needs time to speak.
zh: 慢慢吃，身体需要时间开口。

en: Some doors close so better ones can open.
zh: 有些门关上，是为更好的门打开。

en: Consistency beats intensity.
zh: 持续，胜过用力。

en: Make peace with imperfect progress.
zh: 与不完美的进步和解。

en: You can rest without quitting.
zh: 可以休息，但别放弃。

en: Hydrate, move, breathe, repeat.
zh: 喝水、活动、呼吸，重复。

en: What matters is rarely urgent.
zh: 重要的事，往往并不紧急。

en: Be gentle; you're doing better than you think.
zh: 温柔点，你做得比自己以为的好。

en: A craving fades if you wait it out.
zh: 嘴馋这件事，等一等就过去了。

en: Plant patience; harvest peace.
zh: 种下耐心，收获平静。

en: You don't need permission to change.
zh: 改变，不需要谁的许可。

en: Lift your eyes; the view is bigger than today.
zh: 抬起头，世界比今天更辽阔。

en: Win the morning, win the day.
zh: 赢得清晨，便赢得一天。

en: Discomfort is the price of growth.
zh: 不适，是成长的代价。

en: Choose progress you can sustain.
zh: 选择你能坚持的进步。

en: Stop shoulding on yourself.
zh: 别总用“应该”逼自己。

en: Feed your hunger, not your stress.
zh: 喂饱饥饿，而不是喂饱压力。

en: A calm mind makes better choices.
zh: 平静的心，做更好的选择。

en: Keep the promises you make to yourself.
zh: 对自己许的诺，也要守。

en: Every expert was once a beginner.
zh: 每个高手，都曾是新手。

en: Rest is productive too.
zh: 休息，同样是一种生产力。

en: Let today be enough.
zh: 让今天，就足够好。

en: Walk it off, then think it through.
zh: 先走一走，再慢慢想。

en: Small and steady wins.
zh: 小而稳，赢到最后。

en: Your habits vote for your future.
zh: 你的习惯，在为未来的你投票。

en: Be patient with yourself; growth is quiet.
zh: 对自己有耐心，成长是无声的。

en: One good choice invites the next.
zh: 一个好选择，会带来下一个。
